test.yml/queue-baseline.reason: Restores the exact base tree baseline for the coverage ratchet; the ratchet needs it and is the gate once it lands.

equivalence.yml/ledger-equivalence.reason: Opt in replay of ledger storage and pages; the equivalence gate task wires it into the gate.

gate-protected.yml/grade.reason: Grades the head's Gate Required wiring from the base branch on pull_request_target and reports its verdict as the Gate Required status, so the aggregator it guards cannot need it.

test-leaks.yml/one-process.reason: Hour long single process sweep that runs on a schedule; its pull request run only exercises its own workflow. Retired when the pull request trigger leaves test leaks, which a dispatch run replaces.
